name: Freshcaller
description: Freshcaller is Freshworks' cloud contact-center product for inbound and outbound calling, queues, IVR, routing, teams, call monitoring, recordings, and operational analytics.
agentUseSummary: Enter one Freshcaller account domain and user API key, then let selected agents use bounded call-performance metrics or approved documented API v1 requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: FRESHCALLER_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Freshcaller API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy your API key from Freshcaller Profile Settings. Its access follows your account role.

capabilities.label: Read call metrics
capabilities.description: Read bounded call-performance metrics without phone numbers, participants, recordings, agents, teams, tags, lifecycle traces, integrated resources, or exports.

capabilities.label: Freshcaller API v1
capabilities.description: Use documented API v1 operations allowed by the connected Freshcaller user API key.

approvalRequired.label: List call metrics
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of bounded Freshcaller call-performance metrics.

approvalRequired.label: Read call metrics
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded performance metrics for one exact Freshcaller call.

approvalRequired.label: Use Freshcaller API v1
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Freshcaller API v1 operation authorized by the connected user API key; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded call-metric reads and every broader API operation require approval; tenant binding, secret isolation, provider roles, and limits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected API-key-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; exact tenant binding, secret isolation, bounds, audits, provider roles, and Freshcaller limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API key only to the exact normalized freshcaller.com tenant.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API key only to the exact normalized freshcaller.com tenant.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Freshcaller domain and user API key are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer enters the account name before .freshcaller.com and user API key, then Relay verifies health, bounded metric reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader API behavior, key reset, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Freshcaller's official API reference documents per-user API keys in X-Api-Auth, exact freshcaller.com account origins, role authorization, status errors, and rate limits.
Freshcaller documents list and exact-call metric endpoints, page/per-page controls, duration and cost metrics, and optional lifecycle data that Relay excludes from bounded tools.
Freshcaller documents call, recording, user, and team exports as admin operations, supporting Relay's exclusion of exports and recordings from bounded V1 reads.
